div.div: الاغزآء and المغزى [app. الأَغْزَآءُ and ↓ المَغْزَى , the former a pl. of which the sing. is not mentioned, and the latter a quasi-pl. n. like المَرْجَلُ from الرَّجُلُ,] The offspring (نَتَائِج [more properly نِتَاج, which agrees with the context,]) of the [season called] صَيْف, on the authority of IAar, [meaning such offspring of camels, for it is added,] which are discommended, the young camel thereof being always weak. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
